body.name: Computable variance-envelope critical value
body.construction: For \(v,B_0\ge0\), define \(q_{\alpha}(v,B_0)=\inf\{t\ge0:\Pr(|\sqrt v\,\varepsilon+B_0(C_{k,a})_1|\le t)\ge1-\alpha\}\) and \(q_{*,\alpha}(u,B_0)=\max_{0\le v\le u}q_{\alpha}(v,B_0)\). Compute it by Gaussian--spherical integration, scalar quantile search, and compact one-dimensional maximization.
